criteria_results.notes: research-brief.md is registered (rev 2, 4636 bytes). It has section 1, Executive recommendation; section 2, Factual findings; and a separate section 3, Limitations. Every inline citation uses the exact form [S1], [S2] or [S3]. evidence-alder.md and evidence-brook-cove.md are retained as registered artifacts, and each carries an attribution header naming the researcher child role, its site scope and the mission ID.

criteria_results.criterion: Include a Sources section mapping S1 to sources/pilot-charter.txt, S2 to sources/weekly-observations.txt, and S3 to sources/reviewer-note.txt; cite every substantive factual or numerical claim and do not invent sources. Put an inline citation on every factual bullet and every factual Markdown table row, including the site-totals rows.
criteria_results.notes: Section 4, Sources, maps S1, S2 and S3 to the correct files. All three site-totals table rows (Alder, Brook, Cove) carry [S2]. Every bullet in the recommendation, findings and limitations sections carries a citation. Each cited claim checked against the source text is supported (for example, 31/43/37 and 2/4/3 from S2, 18/11 minutes from S1, and the Alder ranking and decision gate from S3). No other source is referenced.

criteria_results.criterion: State the three 480-request site totals, 31/43/37 delayed acknowledgements for Alder/Brook/Cove, and the 18-to-11-minute acknowledgement median change with supporting citations.
criteria_results.notes: The table and section 2.1 state 480/480/480 requests and 31/43/37 delayed acknowledgements, cited [S2]. These match the S2 lines for ALDER, BROOK and COVE. Section 2.2 states the median change from 18 to 11 minutes, cited [S1], which matches the S1 BASELINE and PILOT lines.

criteria_results.criterion: Explicitly bound conclusions to weekday pilot sites Alder, Brook and Cove and exclude weekend and Depot generalization; do not claim a completed wider rollout.
criteria_results.notes: The executive recommendation states the conclusions apply only to the weekday pilot sites Alder, Brook and Cove and exclude weekend and Depot generalization [S1] [S3]. It says the brief is not approval of a wider rollout and that no wider rollout is reported as completed. The limitations section repeats the weekday-only and no-wider-rollout bounds.

criteria_results.criterion: Use the real Head/MissionManager with exactly one top-level research-coordinator delegation and no other top-level delegation; that coordinator must use the delegate tool to launch exactly two distinct children in parallel before synthesizing the cited brief.
criteria_results.notes: The execution output shows only the research-coordinator at top level, and its tools list includes delegate. The coordinator reports one executed delegate call with parallel:true and two distinct researcher children, one for Alder and one for Brook and Cove. A first malformed attempt was rejected on a schema error and reportedly spawned no children. The two attributed child notes were persisted before research-brief.md, which is consistent with this account. The delegation tree itself was not supplied for direct inspection, so this check relies on the execution record and the artifact set.

defects.issue: evidence-brook-cove.md open question 2 says the sources do not state how many sampled records came from Brook or Cove individually, but S2 states 60 records were sampled per site, as the same note says elsewhere. The note contradicts itself. The brief does not repeat the error.
The brief's executive recommendation refers to 'the Depot site', while S1 calls it 'the Depot trial'. The scope meaning is unchanged, but the wording drifts slightly from the source.

Parallel recursion is evidenced by the execution record and the artifact set, not by a directly supplied delegation tree. The rejected first delegate attempt is disclosed but cannot be independently confirmed as childless.

recommendations: Correct open question 2 in evidence-brook-cove.md to acknowledge that S2 states 60 sampled records per site.
Use the source term 'Depot trial' consistently in the brief.
Include the delegation tree or run log in future candidate epochs so parallel recursion can be verified directly.
review.verdict: PASS: PASS: research-brief.md has a cited executive recommendation, separate findings and limitations, a cited site-totals table with 480/480/480 and 31/43/37, the cited 18-to-11-minute median change, a correct Sources mapping, and explicit weekday, Alder/Brook/Cove-only bounds with no wider-rollout claim. Both attributed child evidence notes are retained, and the execution record shows one coordinator issuing a single parallel delegation to two children. Only minor defects were found.
